shipped_rows.title_o: The influence of colour on memory performance: A review

blind_target.evidence_quote: This study conducted a direct replication of Dzulkifli and Mustafar (2013) in an Indian university population.
blind_target.outcome_quote: This direct replication of Dzulkifli and Mustafar (2013) failed to detect significant effects of colour priming on memory span or sustained attention in a sample of 60 Indian university undergraduates. Warm colour (red) background did not enhance cognitive performance relative to cool colour (blue) or white control conditions.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly report failure to detect the two predicted effects. Low power is discussed, but authors explicitly say their null findings are informative. Target citation is unresolved because the sole Dzulkifli/Mustafar entry is a review, not the empirical primary study attributed in the prose.

luna_triage.reason: The paper explicitly says it replicates Dzulkifli and Mustafar (2013), but its supplied reference is titled “A review,” while the source attributes to it a recognition-memory effect and tests memory span and sustained attention. The exact underlying empirical study/finding being retested is not identified in the supplied evidence, so it is unclear whether row 2543 represents the intended original or whether a distinct primary study is missing. Needed: identification of the empirical primary source behind the reported colour-memory finding and confirmation of which finding this study intended to retest.
luna_triage.omission_quote: This study conducted a direct replication of Dzulkifli and Mustafar (2013) in an Indian university population.
